A chronic inflammatory condition of the middle ear mucosa associated with
recurrent ear discharge, often over a period of years.
Epidemiology
Occurs in two clinical varieties, with mixed bacteriology, usually gram-
negative organisms (Proteus, Pseudomonas)
- The more common simple type with a central eardrum perforation
- The much less common, serious type often associated with the presence of
cholesteatoma
